title: Bug — Pkl source excludes must survive Vaporize Xcode-project generation

dependencies.createdBy: codex from Disk Cleaner V000.000.003 generated-build failure

createdBy: codex from Disk Cleaner V000.000.003 generated-build failure
closeReason: Implemented and verified by commit f8fc286d: Xcode project generation now applies declared exact and glob source exclusions, with CUJ-14 proof coverage.
description: AppleProjectSpec Pkl accepts Source.excludes and the generation receipt preserves those values, but AppleProjectXcodeProjectGenerator discovers every file under the source path without applying them. Disk Cleaner V000.000.003 excluded the retained V000.000.002 @main source to compose its renderer, yet generated world-state compiled both @main declarations and failed. Honor exact and glob exclusions before a PBX file reference or build phase is emitted; do not require consumer copies or historical source rewrites.
acceptanceCriteria: A source entry with an exact exclude omits that file from generated PBX file references and source build phases.
A source entry with a recursive glob exclude omits matching descendants while retaining sibling files.
The configured Pkl-to-Xcode project proving ground covers exclusion behavior.
Disk Cleaner V000.000.003 generates and builds with the V000.000.002 renderer included but its historical @main excluded.
The generation receipt and source signature continue to preserve declared exclusions.
risks: Treating source exclusions as receipt-only metadata lets Pkl report a topology it did not build, causing duplicate entrypoints or accidentally compiled retired code.
Over-broad glob matching can silently omit an intended source; tests must show exact exclusion, recursive exclusion, and retained sibling behavior.
